shellCommands.command: /bin/bash -lc "pwd && rg --files -g 'AGENTS.md' -g 'package.json' -g 'app/**' -g 'src/**' -g 'components/**' | head -80"
/bin/bash -lc "rg --files node_modules/next/dist/docs | rg -i 'view.transition|transition|navigation' | head -80"
/bin/bash -lc 'cat node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/02-guides/instant-navigation.md'
/bin/bash -lc 'cat AGENTS.md && cat package.json && rg --files app'
/bin/bash -lc 'cat node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/02-guides/view-transitions.md'
/bin/bash -lc "for f in app/page.tsx app/product/'[slug]'/page.tsx app/layout.tsx app/globals.css app/ProductSkeleton.tsx app/ProductGrid.tsx; do echo \"FILE "'$f"; cat "$f"; done'

/bin/bash -lc "rg -n 'transitionTypes|ViewTransition|addTransitionType' node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/03-api-reference/02-components/link.md node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/03-api-reference/04-functions/navigation.md node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/02-guides/view-transitions.md | head -110"

/bin/bash -lc "cat node_modules/react/package.json | head -35; cat node_modules/next/package.json | head -22; rg -n 'ViewTransition|addTransitionType' node_modules/@types/react/index.d.ts node_modules/react/index.js node_modules/react/cjs/react.development.js | head -70"

/bin/bash -lc "rg --files -g '"'!node_modules'"' | head -70; cat lib/products.ts; cat tsconfig.json; rg -n 'transitionTypes' node_modules/next/dist/client/app-dir/link.* node_modules/next/dist/client/app-dir/link.d.ts | head -35"

/bin/bash -lc "rg -n 'react|react-dom' node_modules/next/package.json | tail -25; sed -n '2020,2105p' node_modules/@types/react/index.d.ts; sed -n '500,545p' node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/03-api-reference/02-components/link.md"

/bin/bash -lc "node -e \"const r=require('react'); console.log(r.version, typeof r.ViewTransition, typeof r.addTransitionType)\"; node -e \"const r=require('next/dist/compiled/react'); console.log(r.version, typeof r.ViewTransition, typeof r.addTransitionType)\"; cat next.config.ts; git status --short"
/bin/bash -lc "git diff -- package.json; sed -n '1,60p' package-lock.json; rg -n 'viewTransition' node_modules/next/dist/server/app-render/*.js | head -15"
/bin/bash -lc 'npm view react version && npm view react-dom version && npm view @types/react version && npm view @types/react-dom version'
/bin/bash -lc 'npm install --save-exact react@19.3.1 react-dom@19.3.1'

/bin/bash -lc "git diff -- app/page.tsx app/product/'[slug]'/page.tsx app/ProductGrid.tsx app/globals.css package.json; node -e \"const r=require('react'); console.log(r.version, typeof r.ViewTransition, typeof r.addTransitionType)\""
/bin/bash -lc "which chromium || which chromium-browser || which google-chrome || true; rg --files node_modules | rg '/(playwright|puppeteer)(-core)?/' | head -10"
/bin/bash -lc 'npm run build'

/bin/bash -lc "rg -n 'shared|share=|Suspense|fallback' node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/02-guides/view-transitions.md | tail -25; rg -n 'prefetch.*full|prefetch=\\{true\\}' node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/02-guides/optimizing-prefetching.md | head -25"
/bin/bash -lc 'git status --short; git diff -- tsconfig.json; npm ls react react-dom next --depth=0'
/bin/bash -lc 'npm run start -- --port 3100'
/bin/bash -lc "curl -fsS http://localhost:3100/ | python3 -c 'import sys; s=sys.stdin.read(); print({x:s.count(x) for x in [\"/product/classic-sneakers\", \"product-image\", \"Products\"]})'"

/bin/bash -lc "curl -fsS http://localhost:3100/product/classic-sneakers | python3 -c 'import sys; s=sys.stdin.read(); print({x:s.count(x) for x in [\"Back to products\", \"product-hero\", \"Classic Sneakers\", \"Timeless design\"]})'"
/bin/bash -lc 'git show HEAD:tsconfig.json > tsconfig.json'

/bin/bash -lc "python3 -c 'from pathlib import Path; import shutil; root = Path(\"/workspace\"); build = root / \".next\"; env = root / \"next-env.d.ts\"; assert build.is_dir() and env.is_file(); shutil.rmtree(build); env.unlink(); print(\"Removed generated Next.js build files\")'"
/bin/bash -lc "nl -ba app/ProductGrid.tsx | head -50; nl -ba app/product/'[slug]'/page.tsx | sed -n '38,100p'; nl -ba app/page.tsx | head -50; nl -ba app/globals.css | sed -n '120,230p'"

/bin/bash -lc "git status --short; git diff --check; git diff --stat; node -e \"const p=require('./package-lock.json'); console.log(p.packages[''].dependencies.react,p.packages[''].dependencies['react-dom'])\""
/bin/bash -lc "find /usr/local/bin /usr/bin -maxdepth 1 \\( -iname '*chrom*' -o -iname '*firefox*' -o -iname '*webkit*' \\) -print | head -20"
/bin/bash -lc 'ls -d /home/vercel-sandbox/.cache/ms-playwright/* 2>/dev/null | head -10'
